column1: # Scripts of the DeployerSettings oracle (DeployerSettingsOracle.java) and of its Rust twin (deployer_settings_cases.rs): id<TAB>section<TAB>operations.
# The section is the body of `pekko.actor.deployment { ... }` over the reference configuration; \n is a new line and \uXXXX one UTF-16 unit.
# Operations (separated by "; "): find A/B/C (Deployer.lookup of the elements, "-" none, "" the empty element) and lookup URI (an ActorPath).
# The result is the error of building the Deployer (ERR <Exception> [<message>]), or one token per operation: none | the deployment found.
# CO-* cases collide on one path: Rust follows the temporary alphabetical policy of Q-CFG-36 (proposed), so those that differ from Pekko are pending in the twin.
DS-01 an empty section keeps only the entries of reference.conf
